heroText: Mecca works best as a base in Saudi Arabia when you anchor days around Masjid al-Haram, Kaaba and Abraj Al Bait. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Mecca International Airport handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

hotelIntro: Mecca hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use City centre for sightseeing, Old Town for a different local base, and Waterfront or Airport area when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.

history.label: 2nd century
history.text: Historically, there has been a general consensus in scholarship that Macoraba mentioned by Ptolemy in the 2nd century CE is indeed Mecca, but more recently, this has been questioned.

history.label: 5th century
history.text: In the 5th century, the Quraish took control of Mecca, and became skilled merchants and traders.

history.label: 7th century
history.text: Up to the 7th century, this journey was intended for religious reasons by the pagan Arabs to pay homage to their shrine, and to drink Zamzam.
The first clear reference to Mecca in non-Islamic literature appears in 741, long after the death of Muhammad, in the Byzantine-Arab Chronicle or Chronicle of 741.
In 2010, Mecca and the surrounding area became an important site for paleontology with respect to primate evolution, with the discovery of a Saadanius fossil.

history.text: Mecca's most important pagan deity was Hubal, which had been placed there by the ruling Quraysh tribe, and remained until the Conquest of Mecca by Muhammad.

history.label: Regional role
history.text: Although the area around Mecca was completely barren, it was the wealthiest of the three settlements with abundant water from the renowned Zamzam Well and a position at the crossroads of major caravan routes.
